question: To whom is the sacred offering caru especially dear at all times?
premises: The offering is identified as this caru.
Siddhas and yoginīs are named as its recipients or devotees.
It is described as always dear to them.
inference: This caru is always dear to the siddhas and the yoginīs.
plain_english: This sacred offering is always dear to the siddhas and to the yoginīs.
